Codex Context Window v0.1.1 removes lifecycle messages that did not give the model actionable information. New-session, cleared-session, and subagent-start notices added context noise without reporting exact usage or changing how the model should work.

The plugin now keeps one lifecycle signal: compaction. This transition matters because important task state can be reduced or lost, while a lower usage percentage alone does not explain why the context suddenly became smaller. The compact signal now asks the model to verify that the task goal, requirements, decisions, and current progress were preserved.

## What changed

- **Less context noise** — `SessionStart(startup)`, `SessionStart(clear)`, and `SubagentStart` no longer inject redundant messages.
- **Safer continuation after compaction** — `SessionStart(compact)` asks the model to verify the task goal, requirements, decisions, and current progress before continuing.
- **Focused hook coverage** — precise usage reporting remains available through `UserPromptSubmit` and `PostToolUse`.

Precise context usage from `UserPromptSubmit` and `PostToolUse` is unchanged:

```text
<meta>YOUR CONTEXT WINDOW: 193800 / 258400 (75%)</meta>
```

## Upgrade

Refresh the marketplace and reinstall the plugin:

```bash
codex plugin marketplace upgrade codex-context-window
codex plugin add codex-context-window@codex-context-window
```

Then open a new chat or restart Codex so the updated hooks are loaded.

## Compatibility

This release has no breaking configuration changes and supports the same macOS, Linux, and Windows targets as v0.1.0.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/nleononline/codex-context-window/compare/v0.1.0...v0.1.1
